svg.title: Home infrastructure network topology
svg.desc: Current physical links and planned VLAN migrations for the RB5009 router, FRITZ!Box, Synology NAS, Aruba access point, wired clients, Raspberry Pis, Wi-Fi networks, IoT devices, and home-cloud virtual machines.
svg.text: Implemented Home Cloud + retained physical wiring · planned migrations dashed · updated 2026-10-02

g.text: Core router · VLAN gateway · authoritative DHCP · DNS · native TFTP · firewall/NAT
NAS, storage appliance and VMM host · Bond 1 / syno1
Services on VLAN 100 · VMM external switch VLAN 400
Current control planes · etcd quorum 2 of 3
Guest printer access: IPP/631 as needed
Future VLAN 500 storage and VLAN 900 WAN transit
are reserved ideas, not active architecture.

svg.text: Physical wiring retained from existing documentation; not rediscovered. VLAN 400 is implemented. Aruba has no Home Cloud VLAN requirement.

g.text: Implemented Home Cloud · Talos 1.14.2 / Kubernetes 1.37.1 / Cilium 1.20.2
All four VMs and their persistent storage share Synology DS923+ — one physical failure domain, not independent hardware HA.
boot assets (repo menu still HTTP / old ID)
All node IPs: 192.168.40.x · VMM VLAN 400 · DHCP reservations · iscsi-tools installed on all four nodes
RAID10 / Btrfs backing · tested persistent LUN
Validated storage: provision → attach → write → pod replacement → controlled worker reboot + remount; backup restore still untested.
Argo / Gateway activation · HA / quantum migration · Pi workers · independent-disk Ceph only later
Source YAML + persistent private PKI → generated Talos configs. Ordinary container images and Cilium OCI chart still come from public registries.
Application layer · prepared in Git, operator deployment pending
Already working: four Cilium peers ASN 65001 ↔ RB5009 ASN 65000 · LB pool 10.40.0.0/24 · allocated VIP /32 advertisements only
Bootstrap remains independent: Talos → Gateway CRDs + Cilium Helm/CRs → Argo Helm → root sync → Gateway/routes.
TLS renewal/import, DNS, Git repository access and live acceptance remain operator actions. No Home Assistant or Raspberry Pi changes.
Argo-owned · TXT owner home-cloud · exact names only · dry-run → upsert-only → tested sync
Dedicated account · verified TLS · manual infrastructure / legacy app records protected

svg.text: Operator-reported state + prepared configuration, 2026-10-02. Bootstrap/recovery: docs/gitops.md. DNS activation and ownership gates: docs/external-dns.md.
